author: Stuarts
body:
Greetings ,
If you managed to stumble upon this post it must be because you're looking for members,

welp

here I am if anyone/anything wants me in their team......

About me and why I am worthy of joining your team:
 - I am a long time Avicus player
 - I have strategy when I play games ( even if i don't go directly for the monument )
 - I am quite active and I shall be active on your team
 - I am not boring even though I tend not to like using my mic
 - I am fluent in French and English so hmu if you speak both :U
 - I don't shave my legs
 - I am respectfull towards others even though I can be silly at times
 
A little more about me:
 - 18 years old
 - TimeZone: Paris , France
 - Played MC since 1.2.5 version
 - Have been high ranking staff on several servers and have owned a few
 - Have mostly soup pvp'd so I'm good with the sword
 - The bow is not my prefered weapon / bow spamming is not my thing
 
Contact Info:
 - Throw a bottle at sea and I'll get it eventually
 - Discord: Stuart [Drengia]#4374
 - I have TeamSpeak but I'd rather use Discord ^
 - Message me if you see my face during a game

I hope that I convinced you to consider me joining your crew/team/tea party

                   - PEACE !

replies.author: Stuarts
replies.body:
Usually I play offensive , but I'm not a good rusher on crowded games.

I am great at Offense and Offensive defence as in I'll be a great obstacle to any rushers trying to get by.

My preffered way of playing is going with a team-mate on the ennemy field erradicating any threat that tries to leave their side.
But when I can't find a team-mate able to help me , I usually play solo offensive wich means I try to destabalize the other team as much as I can before several of them gang up on me.

On maps with very little running space such as Senex/SenexII I help the bridgers secure the bridges so that the team won't get shot off easily.

I am not a scaffolder so I don't build anything remotley as fast as anyone else, and I am not very skillfull when it comes to building stairs upwards as fast as I've see some do. I'm not incapable but it's not my strong point.
